readme: FROZEN FIXTURE for audit-semantic-identity.ps1 -SelfTest (2026-09-06, PLAN-top5 area 4). NOT a live ledger - nothing reads it but the self-test. Frozen here: the coconut-oil entry is copied verbatim from the 2026-07-30 ruling because it IS the founding case (an Epsom-salt bath soap held the coconut-oil crown 46% under the real cheapest), and one reversed entry is added so the history arm - a reversed ruling is a record, not a gate - is exercised too. Do not regenerate from the live ledger.
